justification: A shows only rows of abstract linear script-like signs set within a border frame around a blank field, while B shows an elaborate frontal anthropomorphic figure with an ornate headdress, pectoral rosette, and weapons (spear-thrower and bow) held in each hand, flanked by hanging pointed objects. There is no shared subject matter, no shared relationship between elements, and no shared manner of depiction beyond the trivial fact that both use outlined marks.
